structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions

law.text: As used in this chapter, unless the context requires a different meaning: "Department" means the Department of Health Professions. "Director" means the Director of the Department of Health Professions. "Health regulatory board" or "regulatory board" means any board included within the Department of Health Professions as provided in § 54.1-2503.
